subject.title: fix(reef): add timeout and bounded JSON reads to relay transport

question: Should all Reef relay HTTP operations use the proposed fixed 15-second response-header deadline?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and sound, but the duration is a user-visible availability contract spanning authentication, friend operations, mail pulls, sends, and acknowledgements; the available repository evidence does not establish the intended relay latency budget.

options.title: Accept 15 seconds
options.body: Adopt the proposed relay-wide deadline and merge after required checks pass on the final head.

options.title: Retune the deadline
options.body: Choose a Reef-owned duration based on supported relay behavior, then refresh the stall and recovery proof for that value.

options.title: Defer timeout policy
options.body: Keep the PR open until the Reef service contract can define a safe common or operation-specific deadline.

recommendation.title: Accept 15 seconds
recommendation.body: Adopt the proposed relay-wide deadline and merge after required checks pass on the final head.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently changed and proved the same shared Reef relay request path on current main.
